title: TOML grammar packaged separately so shell, search, and diff editors can share it without duplication
context: Three editors need TOML highlighting (.kaava, kaava.toml, Cargo.toml). Apps cannot import each other. Importing from packages avoids drift.
decision: Hand-write Monarch TOML grammar in @openkaava/monaco-languages package under packages/. All consumers import registerToml from there.
consequences: One place where TOML is highlighted. Duplication prevented. Three separate consumers can update once and stay in sync.
